stories.title: US EIA lifts Brent forecast to $98 as Iran war tightens global supplies

en.title: US EIA lifts Brent forecast to $98 as Iran war tightens global supplies
en.summary: The US Energy Information Administration raised its oil price forecasts, projecting Brent crude to average $98 per barrel in 2026 due to supply constraints. Diesel prices are expected to decline gradually to around $4.50 by 2027 as Middle Eastern production improves.

stories.title: Fed plans bank-supervision overhaul to strengthen accountability, says Vice Chair Michelle Bowman

en.title: Fed plans bank-supervision overhaul to strengthen accountability, says Vice Chair Michelle Bowman
en.summary: The Federal Reserve will restructure its bank supervision system by establishing five new geographic supervisory regions to improve accountability and decision-making. The changes respond to concerns from a review of Silicon Valley Bank's collapse and include reconsideration of regulatory asset thresholds.
